visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a weathered copper-colored sign for 'Maito Design Works' mounted on a grey textured wall, followed by the shop window of 'Thorough Brace' displaying leather bags on illuminated glass shelves. The street and buildings are reflected on the glass, and a blue backpack is prominent. (2) At 10:00 AM, the scene shifts to the exterior of '水木屋馬場商店', a traditional store with wooden frames and many woven baskets displayed outside. The camera zooms in on racks filled with assorted wicker baskets of various shapes and sizes in the bright natural daylight. (3) By 10:30 AM, '角田商店' is shown with a red 'SALE' sign, followed by colorful leather hides hanging on a rack. At 11:30 AM, 'Kakimori' stationery store is featured, showing wooden shelves organized with pens and paper, including a sample card with a cat drawing. (4) At 1:30 PM, 'Bark Bake & Roast' cafe is shown with a 'Dogs are welcome' sign. A woman drinks iced coffee next to an ice cream pastry on a wooden table. At 2:30 PM, 'Futo' focuses on a woman writing a letter under warm indoor lighting. (5) The process of melting red and gold wax and pressing a seal onto an envelope is shown in detail. At 4:00 PM, the unmanned '透明書店' and the colorful washi tape wall of 'mt lab.' at 4:20 PM are displayed. Finally, 'OSAJI' and 'NOCE' shops appear.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 蔵前散策 Kuramae. [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. (2) [Logo]: Thorough Brace. [Subtitle]: 跟我一起逛蔵前. (3) [Subtitle]: 10:00 水木屋馬場商店. (4) [Subtitle]: 買藤編包就要來這 款式多到選擇障礙. (5) [Subtitle]: 10:30 角田商店. [Slogan]: SALE 10% OFF!. (6) [Subtitle]: 有在玩皮革的必訪 超多皮料可以挑選. (7) [Subtitle]: 11:30 Kakimori. (8) [Subtitle]: 蔵前知名文具坊 筆具、紙張種類多 還能製作專屬筆記本. (9) [Subtitle]: 13:30 BARK BAKE & ROAST. [Slogan]: DOGS ARE WELCOME!. (10) [Subtitle]: 蔵前神社旁咖啡廳 寵物友善、可頌冰淇淋夾心好好吃. (11) [Subtitle]: 14:30 封灯 FUTO. (12) [Subtitle]: 蔵前特色店家 可以寫信給一年後的自己. (13) [Subtitle]: 選擇喜歡的顏色 用蠟來製作封印. (14) [Subtitle]: 充滿情緒的一間店 很適合想來思考的人們. (15) [Subtitle]: 16:00 透明書店. (16) [Subtitle]: 24小時無人商店 很多特別書籍. (17) [Subtitle]: 16:20 mt lab.. (18) [Subtitle]: mt紙膠帶專門店 愛玩紙膠帶的話一定要來. (19) [Subtitle]: 店內款式真的超多. (20) [Subtitle]: 下次留點時間給蔵前吧.
